page.overview:
Who is Adam Strange?

Adam had several adventures on Rann; and on two occasions he required the help of the Justice League.

Shadow Thief stole Zeta-Beam technology, framing Thanagarians in the process. After being released from Hawkman's mind, he was able to escape Rann. Adam was able to track his movements, but couldn't catch-up to him. He made his way to Paris, where he found Green Lantern and Hawkgirl investigating Shadow Thief's latest crime scene. Adam brought the pair to home of the Gruktharr. Attracting the natives, Shadow Thief took the opportunity to capture Hawkgirl. He began to gloat that their weapons couldn't harm him, only for Green Lantern to shoot him with a Nth Metal bullet.
